title: 第212章 心意确认第211章 奖励定制
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 陈然整个人僵在原地。
刚才那句话本来只是随口一说的玩笑话。
谁能想到林琬竟然真的回应了。
陈然张了张嘴，一时间竟然不知道该说什么。
林琬脸上不知何时染上了一层霞红。
她低着头，双手紧紧攥着衣袖。
“我不是开玩笑的。“
“我……我是认真的。“
陈然脑子短暂宕机了一阵。
他最开始认识林琬，纯粹就是把她当成一个送犯人的工具人。
后来接触多了发现这个女人虽然表面冷冰冰的，但其实是个外冷内热型的，为人极其正直，做事也有自己的原则。
再到后来他对于林琬的态度也不知不觉间发生了变化。
陈然沉默了好一会儿。
林琬等了半天也没听到回答，心里越来越慌。
她咬着唇，声音带上了一丝颤抖。
“如果你不愿意的话……那就……那就当我没说过。“
“反正之前说的挡箭牌也是真的，你不用有负担……“
话还没说完。
陈然突然伸手，把她揽进了怀里。
林琬整个人都僵住了。
她能清楚地感受到陈然胸膛传来的温度，还有那平稳有力的心跳声。
“别说话。“
陈然低声道。
“让我想想。“
林琬乖乖地闭上了嘴，心跳快得不行。
陈然低头看着怀里的女人，心里有些复杂。
他确实没想过会跟林琬真的发展到这一步。
但如果说对林琬一点感觉都没有，那也是假的。
这段时间接触下来，林琬的性格他已经摸得差不多了。
这个女人虽然高冷，但骨子里是个极其较真的人。
她既然说出口了，那就不会是随便说说。
陈然抬起手，轻轻拍了拍林琬的后背。
林琬身子一颤，猛地抬起头。
“你……你答应了？“
content_en:
Chen Ran froze in place.
The sentence just now was just a casual joke.
Who would have thought that Lin Wan would actually respond.
Chen Ran opened his mouth, but for a moment he didn't know what to say.
"You..."
Lin Wan's face was stained with a layer of rosy red at some point.
She lowered her head and clenched her sleeves with her hands.
"I'm not kidding."
"I...I'm serious."
Chen Ran's mind went blank for a while.
When he first met Lin Wan, he simply regarded her as a tool to transport prisoners.
Later, after getting to know her more, I discovered that although this woman looks cold on the outside, she is actually cold on the outside and hot on the inside. She is extremely upright and has her own principles in doing things.
Later, his attitude towards Lin Wan also changed unconsciously.
Chen Ran was silent for a while.
Lin Wan waited for a long time but did not hear an answer, and became more and more panicked.
She bit her lip, her voice trembling.
"If you don't want to...then...just pretend I didn't say it."
"Anyway, the shield I mentioned before is true. You don't have to be burdened..."
The words are not finished yet.
Chen Ran suddenly reached out and took her into his arms.
Lin Wan's whole body froze.
She could clearly feel the warmth coming from Chen Ran's chest, as well as the steady and powerful heartbeat.
"Chen Ran...you..."
"Don't talk."
Chen Ran whispered.
"Let me think about it."
Lin Wan shut her mouth obediently, her heart beating so fast.
Chen Ran looked down at the woman in his arms, feeling a little complicated.
He really never thought that he and Lin Wan would really develop to this point.
But it would be false to say that he has no feelings for Lin Wan at all.
Through this period of contact, he has almost figured out Lin Wan's character.
Although this woman is aloof, she is an extremely serious person at heart.
Now that she said it, she wouldn't say it casually.
Chen Ran raised his hand and patted Lin Wan's back gently.
Lin Wan trembled and raised his head suddenly.
"You...you agreed?"
